pins.title: Grand Canyon: the hard part comes last
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Grand Canyon hiking tip: the climb out is the hard part, so pick your turnaround time before you start down
pins.description: Below the South Rim every trail starts downhill, so the easy part comes first and the long climb back up comes last, when you are tired and it may be hot. Decide your turnaround time before you start, and turn around when you reach it. Our Grand Canyon South Rim Trip Planning Guide covers rim walks, day hikes and planning. Instant PDF download.
